findings.summary: environment/access: sandbox cannot reach live local stack
findings.detail: Health probes to http://127.0.0.1:8090/bridge/healthz and http://127.0.0.1:4041/health failed with curl exit 7. Process inspection shows this Codex command is running under bwrap with --unshare-net, so the sandbox has an isolated network namespace. pm2 status also failed with EPERM against /home/ydyk/.pm2 sockets/logs. No accounts were provisioned and no agent turns were sent because the live bridge/gateway are inaccessible from this sandbox.

problems: environment/access: live bridge and gateway are inaccessible from the sandbox network namespace; smoke could not start provisioning or turns
